task: Harden promo pack kit rig gates: measurement-backed GLB-direct rig QA
resume_brief: STANDALONE BRIEF — harden the rig QA side of the promo pack kit (owner 2026-10-08: rig work must be more robust and stronger). CONTEXT: docs/promo/PROMO_PACK_KIT.md + tools/promo-pack-kit/ exist on Bannon main (commit a92a201). promo_gates.py currently EVALUATES a metrics JSON that someone else measured — that is weak; a gate that trusts unmeasured inputs proves nothing. BUILD: tools/promo-pack-kit/rig_measure.py — measures rig quality DIRECTLY from GLB files, then feeds promo_gates.py via a --measure mode (or emits the metrics JSON the gates already consume). Measurements to implement: (1) rotation error effective degrees vs reference rest pose — reproduce the QA chart metric (XBot ref 0.0deg PASS / BANNON_v1 5.1deg FAIL / Cody tripo 7.0deg FAIL, Body_JabCross.glb mixamocom 2.08s) so the gate cross-validates those exact numbers on the real files; (2) feet min-Y vs ground plane from mesh geometry (floating detection, no trusted input); (3) skin-weight audit: verts with zero total weight, verts bound to >4 joints, single-joint dominance spots (the shoulder-flap class of defect); (4) rest-pose sanity: A/T-pose classification, left/right bone-length symmetry, zero-length bones. DRY PRE-SEARCH FIRST (repo AGENTS.md law): grep tools/unirig/, tools/mocap_ingester/validate_retargeting.py, and ~/workspace/bannon-video-pipe (gate_check.cjs, harness/) for existing GLB measurement code — reuse/extend, do not duplicate. Check python env for trimesh/pygltflib/numpy; use ~/workspace/venvs if needed; free/open-source only. VERIFY: run rig_measure.py on real repo GLBs and CONFIRM it reproduces ~5.1deg on the BANNON_v1-class model and ~7.0deg on the Cody-tripo-class model from the QA chart — quote the measured numbers; if the models are not in this repo, locate them (~/workspace/bannon-video-pipe/orig-models/, promo-work/, or the Bannon repo assets) and say exactly which files you measured. Update PROMO_PACK_KIT.md section 8 with the new measurement-backed gates and README with the pipeline diagram (measure -> gate -> proof). RULES: heartbeat THIS checkpoint after every commit (never create a new one); commit incrementally; push completed work to Bannon main (push policy: owner-approved work, no secrets in repo); verification law — quote raw tool output, never paraphrase a result as done; media proof standard (§7: real files, inspected frames listed, sha1 fingerprints, before/after proof, no AI faces, version-never-overwrite); FS flakiness seen 2026-10-07 (muse.write silently wrote 0-byte files) — always wc -c after writes and rewrite via shell heredoc if empty; never invent canon; no procedural bone-wiggle posing anywhere. When done mark checkpoint done and report: files, commits, push result, measured numbers vs the QA chart, and which existing code you reused.
